audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer states 'His R true damage ignores your shields' and 'Olaf's R is true damage that ignores any shield and strips his CC immunity'. Ragnarok is not a damage ability.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ragnarok passively grants armour and magic resist and, when activated, makes Olaf immune to disables while he keeps attacking. The true damage is Reckless Swing (E), 325 range on 11/10/9/8/7s, which costs him health and refunds it on a kill. Conflating the two tells a player to fear the wrong button and to mis-time the one window where their R sleep is dead.
audit.corrected: whys[6] and the late-game paragraph rewritten to attribute true damage to Reckless Swing and CC immunity to Ragnarok.
sources: brief enemyKit E text and trueDamage flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradicted the content layer's own whys — most starkly Level 1, marked Lillia while whys[0] says Olaf out-trades her there.
audit.why: Olaf's level 1 is a complete trade (Undertow slow at 1000 range plus Reckless Swing true damage) against Lillia's single ability. Her real windows are Levels 4-5 and the first burn item; Levels 3, 6 and the late game are genuinely contested.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Olaf / Skill / Skill / Lillia / Skill / Lillia / Skill with ratings 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.why: TRICKY at 7/10 fits a 48.95% win rate: Lillia can kite an Olaf with no dash, but Undertow's slow plus the axe-pickup cooldown reset lets him chain slows, and Ragnarok answers her only lockdown.
Undertow is correctly identified as the cooldown to bait, and the axe-pickup reset is already called out in the early-game text — that reset is the reason a flat 9s number understates it.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Olaf out-trades your one-ability level 1 with Undertow's slow and Reckless Swing's true damage.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-kite in circles, E from fog for the slow, and the passive speed makes every trade yours to end.
edits.after: Your burn and stacking move speed make you slippery, but his lifesteal sustains the chip — neither wins clean.

edits.before: The lane is a treadmill he can't get off — Q every step-up, kite the Undertow (Axe) window, and bank Dream Dust burn.
edits.after: Full Q rank plus compounding Dream Dust lets you kite his walk-up and out-grind a man who needs a landed axe.

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby online — your jungler's ganks are now guaranteed, and any overstep becomes a sleep-execute.
edits.after: Your sleep is delayed and Ragnarok goes CC-immune on demand, so the level 6 spike is mutual, not yours.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Liandry's turns W and Dream Dust into percent-HP burn — your skirmish outpaces his first item if you space the axe.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: Reckless Swing's true damage ignores resists and his lifesteal stabilizes — space and roam, don't duel.

edits.before: His R true damage ignores your shields and his sustain stabilizes — play spacing and roam rather than gamble the even 1v1.
edits.after: Reckless Swing's true damage ignores resists and his lifesteal stabilizes — play spacing and roam rather than gamble the 1v1.

edits.before: Once Liandry's/Riftmaker comes online your W and DoT start chunking percent-HP and your skirmish climbs, so cash that into roams and skirmishes before his sustain snowballs. The danger never fully goes away: Olaf's R is true damage that ignores any shield and strips his CC immunity, so if he ults onto you with axe slow up he runs you down through everything and you have no defensive button to answer. Keep your spacing religious, never get pinned against terrain, and win the map rather than the standing 1v1.
edits.after: Once Liandry's/Riftmaker comes online your W and DoT start chunking percent-HP and your skirmish climbs, so cash that into roams and skirmishes before his sustain snowballs. The danger never fully goes away: Reckless Swing is true damage that no resistance reduces and Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so if he ults onto you with axe slow up he runs you down through your sleep and you have no defensive button to answer. Keep your spacing religious, never get pinned against terrain, and win the map rather than the standing 1v1.

notes: Real factual error found and fixed: the content layer twice credited Ragnarok with true damage. Ragnarok is armour/MR plus disable immunity; Reckless Swing (E) is the true damage. spikes[3].text already had this right, so the page contradicted itself. packet.games is null while the brief header says 713 — the 48.95% figure is the one I audited against.
